Square plate, about 26 cm. On it: three slices of roast beef (about 90 g) on a few spinach leaves (about 10 g), plus a piece of potato gratin or cheese-topped casserole (about 100 g).

- Beef: about 90 g × 2 kcal/g ≈ 180 kcal
- Gratin: about 100 g × 1.4 kcal/g ≈ 140 kcal
- Spinach: about 5 kcal
